description: This file defines classes and functions related to multiplayer UI components for the Battle for Wesnoth game, including chat management, network response handling, and UI dialog classes.

classes.name: mp::chat
classes.description: Manages a chat session, storing message history and formatting messages.

classes.name: mp::ui
classes.description: Base class for multiplayer dialog interfaces, handling network data, user interactions, and layout.

methods.name: mp::check_response
methods.description: Handles network response checks.

methods.name: mp::level_to_gamestate
methods.description: Converts level configuration to game state.

methods.name: mp::get_colour_string
methods.description: Returns a string representing a color based on an ID.

methods.name: mp::chat::add_message
methods.description: Adds a message to the chat history.

methods.name: mp::chat::init_textbox
methods.description: Initializes a textbox for chat input.

methods.name: mp::chat::update_textbox
methods.description: Updates the chat textbox with new messages.

methods.name: mp::chat::format_message
methods.description: Formats a chat message for display.

methods.name: mp::ui::ui
methods.description: Constructor for the multiplayer UI dialog.

methods.name: mp::ui::process_network
methods.description: Processes incoming network data.

methods.name: mp::ui::get_result
methods.description: Returns the current result/state of the UI dialog.

methods.name: mp::ui::set_location
methods.description: Sets the position and size of the UI widget.

methods.name: mp::ui::draw_contents
methods.description: Draws the UI contents.

methods.name: mp::ui::process_event
methods.description: Handles user events.

methods.name: mp::ui::handle_event
methods.description: Handles specific SDL events.

methods.name: mp::ui::handle_key_event
methods.description: Handles keyboard events.

methods.name: mp::ui::process_network_data
methods.description: Processes network data received.

methods.name: mp::ui::process_network_error
methods.description: Handles network errors.

methods.name: mp::ui::accept_connections
methods.description: Determines if incoming connections are accepted.

methods.name: mp::ui::process_network_connection
methods.description: Handles new network connections.

methods.name: mp::ui::hide_children
methods.description: Hides or shows child widgets.

methods.name: mp::ui::layout_children
methods.description: Arranges child widgets within the UI.

methods.name: mp::ui::set_result
methods.description: Sets the result/state of the UI dialog.

methods.name: mp::ui::gamelist_updated
methods.description: Callback when the game list is updated.

methods.name: mp::ui::set_user_list
methods.description: Updates the list of users.

methods.name: mp::ui::gamelist
methods.description: Accesses the game list configuration.

methods.name: mp::ui::title
methods.description: Returns the title widget.
